about_short_description.short_description: Al Masraf is a banking firm that provides corporate banking, corporate financing, transaction banking and SME banking services.

product.name: Mobile Banking
product.description: Provides secure online banking access to accounts 24/7 via a mobile app.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Offers financial services tailored for corporate clients, including loans and credit facilities.

product.name: SME Banking
product.description: Provides banking services and financial products specifically designed for small and medium enterprises.

product.name: Transaction Banking
product.description: Facilitates domestic and international transactions, including payments and cash management.

product.name: Corporate Financing
product.description: Offers financing solutions for businesses, including loans and credit lines.
